Package arztis.econnector.ihe.parameters

Class PatientContactParameter

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.common.model.Parameter
arztis.econnector.ihe.parameters.PatientContactParameter
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class PatientContactParameter
extends Parameter
This class is used to pass details about patient contacts in ELGA. It can be used for
  • confirm patient contact
  • query patient contacts
  • cancel patient contact
Author:
Anna Jungwirth

  • Constructor Details

    • PatientContactParameter

      public PatientContactParameter​(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Identifier patientId)
      Constructor to create parameters for the listing of confirmed patient contacts.
      Parameters:
      patientId - ID of patient. It must be bpk ("bereichspezifisches Personenkennzeichen") or social security number.

    • PatientContactParameter

      public PatientContactParameter​(org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Identifier patientId, java.lang.String cardReaderId, java.util.List<ElgaEHealthApplication> apps)
      Constructor to create parameters for the confirmation of patient contact.
      Parameters:
      patientId - ID of patient. It must be bpk ("bereichspezifisches Personenkennzeichen") or social security number.
      cardReaderId - card reader ID, if confirmation is to be executed by using an e-Card
      apps - ELGA eHealth applications for which patient contact should be confirmed

    • PatientContactParameter

      public PatientContactParameter​(java.lang.String tridPatientContact)
      Constructor to create parameters for cancellation of patient contact.
      Parameters:
      tridPatientContact - ID of patient contact

      public java.lang.String getCardReaderId()

      ID of card reader

    • getPatientId

      public org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Identifier getPatientId()
      ID of patient for whom patient contact should be listed, cancelled or registered. If patient contact is to be confirmed by using an e-Card, social security number should be the patient id. If patient contact is to be confirmed by using the bPk, the bPk should be the patient ID.
      Returns:
      ID of patient (bpk or social security number of patient)

    • setPatientId

    • getEhealthApps

      public java.util.List<ElgaEHealthApplication> getEhealthApps()
      ID of eHealth applications for which patient contact should be listed, cancelled or registered. It is needed if patient contact endpoints of eHealth applications differ from default endpoints.
      Returns:
      eHealth applications to confirm patient contact into
